pr.title: docs(planner): design read-only repository merge planner
pr.body:
## Outcome
Defines the Dopemux-hosted, read-only Control Tower planner for Dopemux, dNh CRM, and AdOps.

## Architecture
- dNh tools/gov is the contract source
- AdOps exports repo-local governance evidence
- Dopemux renders the cross-repo projection
- Task Orchestrator remains non-authoritative
- fixture-first, then GitHub GET/HEAD refresh

## Safety
Design-only draft. No runtime changes, model calls, merge authority, or terminal actions. Embedded audit remains required after content freeze.

steps.task: Verify Dopemux, dNh CRM, and AdOps authority and existing architecture seams using read-only repository evidence.

Confirm AdOps PR #277 review findings and current authority files.
validation: The RFC cites only observed repository surfaces.

steps.task: Write the fixture-first planner RFC and implementation plan.
requirements: Keep the DCP nine-family facade unchanged.
Require authority NONE on planner outputs.
Define automatic GitHub evidence refresh, approved conversation decisions, visible conflicts, and deterministic merge simulation.
validation: The plan begins with a canonical implementation packet and frozen fixtures.
